narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -3.46 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 84.159-84.342 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 85.178; the first objective pays 1.12R at 83.980.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 85.178 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
